title: Choose a Class Activity
name: Choose a Class Activity
purpose: An eye-gaze/dwell-safe AAC choice board that lets a student choose, request help, or repair the choice when selecting a class activity.

teacherNotes.modeling: Model the board by saying and selecting options yourself: “I choose Art”, “Help please”, “Different”. Wait after modelling and accept gaze, gesture, voice, partner interpretation, or keyboard selection.
teacherNotes.evidence: Teacher can note whether the student initiates a choice, confirms/rejects an activity, asks for help, or uses Different to repair the offered choices.
teacherNotes.customisation: Replace the four activity labels/search terms with the real lesson choices. Keep Help and Different/Finished-style repair vocabulary stable where possible.
teacherNotes.access: Default dwell is 1000 ms. Targets are arranged 2 by 3 with large buttons, visible dwell progress, pointer-leave cancellation, and keyboard fallback.
teacherNotes.caveat: Draft classroom support only. Review with the teaching/SLP/OT team and test on the actual student device/access setup before relying on it.

symbolStrategy.customMediaPolicy: teacher-owned local media only unless explicitly approved
symbolStrategy.notes: This proof of concept uses text labels and emoji-style inline icons in HTML, with ARASAAC search terms recorded for later symbol replacement.

metadata.curriculum: Classroom participation and communication access: making choices, requesting help, and repairing communication during shared class activities.

attribution.note: Symbol search terms are provided for ARASAAC replacement; confirm exact current licence wording when publishing beyond local classroom use.

sett.student: Student uses eye gaze/dwell, keyboard, touch, or partner interpretation to choose an activity and repair the choice if needed.
sett.environment: Classroom device or AAC setup with large targets, reduced visual clutter, and no dependency on live internet during use.
sett.task: Choose a class activity while keeping Help and Different available.
sett.tools: Two-by-three gaze-safe board, 1000 ms dwell, pointer-leave cancellation, spoken labels, and text/emoji fallback.

differentiation.content: Keep authentic activity choice while protecting gaze access and repair.
differentiation.process: Model key vocabulary, provide wait time, allow rehearsal/repetition, and accept multimodal communication.
differentiation.product: Accept selected activity, repair use, or teacher observation of access fit.
differentiation.environment: Use a calm, predictable, local-first layout with teacher controls separate from student choices.
differentiation.support: Teaching, SLP, OT, family, and student/team review should personalise vocabulary and access before reliance.

participationBarriers.barrier: Activity choice can become adult-controlled or too visually dense for gaze access.
participationBarriers.support: Use six large targets, stable repair vocabulary, clear dwell progress, and keyboard fallback.

evidencePlan.notJudgement: Dwell timing and accidental cancellation reflect access tuning, not preference certainty.
evidencePlan.export: Use anonymous teacher notes, print/portfolio evidence, or local CSV/report only when needed. Do not include diagnoses, behaviour details, family details, or school IDs.
